items.title: Neural network model predicts protein folds faster
items.summary: A deep learning system trained on structural data predicts how proteins fold in minutes, a task machine learning had long struggled with.

items.title: Warming oceans shift fish ranges
items.summary: Climate change is pushing commercial fish stocks toward the poles, and fisheries are racing to adapt.

items.title: Language models show uneven reasoning
items.summary: Large language models, a form of artificial intelligence, solve some puzzles easily and fail at near-identical ones.

items.title: Prison health study links crowding to infection
items.summary: Overcrowding in prisons drives outbreaks, and incarceration policy sets the conditions for them.

items.title: Tree rings reveal a century of drought
items.summary: Records from old trees show how global warming has stretched dry spells across the continent.

items.title: Complex systems approach predicts coral collapse
items.summary: Researchers used a complex systems model with feedback loops to forecast when reefs tip over.

items.title: Robots learn to fold laundry
items.summary: Reinforcement learning, a branch of machine learning, lets a robot arm handle soft fabric, with consequences for automation of household work.

items.title: Sleep loss changes decision making
items.summary: Volunteers deprived of sleep took bigger risks in a gambling task.

items.title: New battery chemistry doubles range
items.summary: A sodium-based cell stores more energy per kilogram than lithium.

items.title: AI model spots early signs of sepsis
items.summary: An AI tool flagged sepsis hours earlier than staff in a hospital trial, raising questions about health care workflows.

items.title: Wildfire smoke linked to health outcomes
items.summary: Climate-driven fires are filling clinics, and health care systems are struggling with the load.

items.title: Feedback loops stabilise gut microbiome
items.summary: Microbial populations hold steady through feedback loops that resemble engineered control systems.
